purpose: Literal colour DATA for branding.test.ts. These are the merchant-supplied inputs, the deliberately invalid inputs and the exact expected outputs of the checkout branding sanitiser, so they must be real #RRGGBB strings: a test of hex handling cannot be written without them, and swapping them for design tokens would make the assertions compare the implementation with itself. Kept as data, not code, because @letbuyy/ui/no-hardcoded-hex polices colour literals in UI code and cannot tell a fixture from a styling decision.

merchantTheme.why: a real resolved merchant theme (snaz-shaped): every colour must flow through unchanged

hostileTheme.why: near-white text on a white background: the exact class of misconfiguration checkout must survive without human review

pureColors.why: the two endpoints the AA fallback may resolve to

accessibleTextColor.why: an already-passing pair is returned as chosen and is not flagged as a fallback
black has better contrast than white against a light background

hexColorSanitization.why: a non-colour string must fall back
a short hex must be rejected
a valid lowercase hex must pass through with its case preserved

lightThemeOverWhite.why: the light-mode muted text tier is measured against a white background
